verdict.reason: Almagreira is worth a quick check for afternoon — 16:00, but it is not a guaranteed session.  Treat it as a check-first call rather than a sure thing.  Wind is the main thing to watch.  The tide and timing are lining up well for this spot.

conversationalSummary.text: TODAY, Almagreira in the afternoon around 16:00 is the best option, but it’s pretty wind-exposed and the wind looks strong, so it could get choppy fast. I’d check Surfline and the MEO Beachcam before leaving—if the cams don’t look notably cleaner than expected, I’d rather skip it. There should be at least enough size with the tide dropping, but wind will be the main decider.

An exposed north-coast beach break with more raw swell than Baleal; this is best for small, clean north-coast days when protected spots look underpowered; 10-13s at low tide can still work on exposed beaches, so checking exposed beaches makes sense.  Watch: wind is over 30 km/h; wind fit is poor or too strong; gusts over 45 km/h add chop risk.
